$skip (required): skips the top number of results. Data Type: integer. Example: $skip=1

$search (optional): search for specific result. Data Type: string. Example: $search=admin

$orderby (optional): order by column name (Name, NoOfMembers, Modified). Data Type: string. Example: $orderby=Name%20desc
